title: UnitRepaired
description: A unit or facility at a friendly base is back to full hp (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY §5, §5b, Q-GD-27): emitted when the repair reaches the unit's maximum hp; each damage-state improvement on the way is a UnitDamageStateChanged. by_id is the engineer that repaired it, null for base repair. Public view: dropped for a hidden ENEMY unit (FOW-13).

by_id.description: The repairing unit; always null until engineers exist (P4).

node_id.description: The base that repaired it; null for a repair away from a base (engineers, P4).
